fullContentHtml:
Rajasthan RPSC Deputy Jailor PET Result 2024 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the result for the post of Deputy Jailor. This recruitment was released for 73 posts. Applications for the RPSC Deputy Jailor Recruitment 2024 were accepted from 08 July 2024, to 06 August 2024. The written examination was held on 13 July 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RPSC Deputy Jailor Result 2025 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 July 2024
  • Last Date : 06 August 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 August 2024
  • Exam Date : 13 July 2025
  • Exam City Details : 07 July 2025
  • Admit Card : 10 July 2025
  • Answer Key : 05 August 2025
  • Result : 19 November 2025 Available Now

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC, BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 400/–
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
